svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — Where the bus stop is a bushwalk
svg.desc: Pen-and-ink editorial cartoon on a suburban street in Mackay, with cane fields and hazy ranges behind, a timber Queenslander house on stumps with lattice and a corrugated roof, a coconut palm, a mango tree, a power pole and a picket fence. A fictional man dressed for an expedition — bush hat, backpack with bedroll and frying pan, canteen, long socks, walking pole and a folded map — stands at his front gate beside a signpost reading Bus stop 4 km and Shops 3 km, saying: Don’t wait up, love — I’m walking to the bus stop. A fictional woman leaning out of the family hatchback in the driveway calls back: Ring me from base camp! Caption: Mackay — where the bus stop is a bushwalk.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY

g.text: I’M WALKING TO THE BUS STOP.

svg.text: MACKAY: WHERE THE BUS STOP IS A BUSHWALK.
Source: ABC Tropical North Queensland, 13 November 2026 — Paywise data says 1.1% of Mackay residents live within 400 m of a bus stop.
